title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Public Lighting - ConsumoEnergetico
description: Observation of electricity consumption in a specific tariff period (edintalu:ConsumoEnergetico, subclass of edint-suministro's UtilityConsumption, itself a sosa:Observation). Each instance represents ONE tariff period; the total for a fiscal year is obtained by summing instances of the same period.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ConsumoEnergetico'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

madeBySensor.description: Relationship. The UtilityMeter that made this observation. Inherited from UtilityConsumption (edint-suministro).

featureOfInterest.description: Relationship. The CentroDeMando (supply point) whose consumption was observed. Inherited from UtilityConsumption (edint-suministro).

observedProperty.description: Relationship. The property observed, e.g. edintsum:electricityConsumption. Inherited from UtilityConsumption (edint-suministro).

result.description: Property. The simple value of the observation, typically an amount in kWh. Inherited from UtilityConsumption (edint-suministro).

resultTime.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Instant when the observation result was generated. Inherited from UtilityConsumption (edint-suministro).

phenomenonTime.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Instant or interval when the observed situation occurred. Inherited from UtilityConsumption (edint-suministro).

periodoTarifario.description: Property. Tariff period this consumption corresponds to (edintalu:periodoTarifario).
